_comment: Model capability catalogue used to validate a task configuration BEFORE any API call.
It is data, not code: extend or correct it with a local override file
(<SYSREV_DATA_DIR>/model_catalogue.json, same format) after checking the provider's
current documentation. A model that is not listed cannot be used (fail closed).
Prices are Standard-tier list prices in USD per million tokens (no Batch/Flex/Fast/regional
variants) and are used only for ESTIMATES;
the provider's invoice is authoritative. null pricing = cost reported as unavailable.
Session 8: verified_at = date the capabilities were checked; pricing_source and
pricing_verified_at = separate evidence for the prices. 2026-10-31 re-check of the Anthropic
pricing page corrected the Claude Sonnet 5.5 cache-read price (0.10, not 0.20) and added the
documented Haiku 5.5 long-prompt cache prices. Historical call records keep the estimate
and basis computed when they were made; nothing is recomputed retroactively.
lifecycle is null (not recorded) unless a provider model-list refresh reported it.
